verdict: Paid ads are off; organic activity is carrying a quiet period.
narrative: This period, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads — meaning no paid leads were generated and cost per lead is not applicable. Your site received 188 sessions over the last 28 days, driven entirely by organic and direct traffic, and your Google Business Profile logged 60 actions including 36 direction requests, 23 web clicks, and 1 call. Week-over-week site activity rose sharply mid-period but has pulled back in the last few days, and Google Business Profile engagement dipped 12.5% in the most recent 7-day window — so both channels are softening heading into next week. Paid campaigns are being reviewed for reactivation, which would restore lead flow; once ads are live, cost per lead and pipeline volume will be the numbers to watch.

highlights.phrase: paid leads this period — no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads
Google Business Profile actions in the last 28 days (directions, web clicks, and calls)
website sessions this period, sustained by organic and direct traffic alone

watch_item.issue: 188 site sessions and 60 profile actions this period have not translated into any pipeline entries, suggesting an intake gap independent of ad spend.
watch_item.fix: The lead intake path is being reviewed now so that when paid campaigns resume, inquiries are captured without leakage.
